hook: Could you actually reach the deepest hole on Earth?
title: How Do You Get to the Deepest Hole on Earth?

beats.line: Fly to Murmansk, far in the Russian Arctic.
beats.label: MURMANSK

beats.line: Then drive to the Kola Peninsula, near Norway.
beats.label: KOLA BOREHOLE

beats.line: At 11,882 metres, the drill hit 180 degrees.
beats.quote: stopped due to higher-than-expected temperatures of 180 °C (356 °F) in 1992 at 11,882 metres

beats.line: They reached 12,262 metres, the deepest hole on Earth.
beats.quote: which attained maximum true vertical depth of 12,262 metres (40,230 ft) in 1989

beats.line: Mount Everest would fit, with 3.4 km to spare.
Down there, the rock was 180 degrees.
beats.label: AT THE BOTTOM
